title: Grandfathering strategy for version retirement + coordinated release notes & GTM
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define a pragmatic retirement (sunset) approach for legacy model API version X that minimizes customer disruption. Deliverables: 1) detailed grandfathering policy for existing customers, 2) coordinated release-note templates and cadence for public docs and SDKs, 3) GTM checklist for support/AE/CS, 4) migration helper tooling guidance and rollback criteria. This ticket covers cross-team coordination: Eng (compat shims, deprecation headers), SDKs (warnings + helpers), Docs (migration guide + changelog automation), Console (flagging deprecated routes + telemetry), Legal/Compliance (data-retention notes for private deployments), and Sales/CS communications.
acceptance_criteria: Grandfathering policy doc published and reviewed by Legal and Security
Release-note cadence and templated messages committed to docs repo
Cross-functional GTM checklist with owners and timelines accepted by PM council
Migration helper scripts and SDK warning plan have implementation tickets and estimates
Rollback and emergency-fallback runbook written and validated with SRE
Customer segmentation list for staged comms created and validated with Sales
tasks: Run kickoff with Eng/SDK/Docs/Console/Sales/CS/Legal — assign leads
Define grandfathering windows (e.g., 12 months full support + 6 months read-only) and exceptions
Coordinate deprecation header and API warning semantics with ENG — spec and example headers
Draft migration guide with code snippets for Node/Python/Go SDKs
Create templated email/Site banner/Console Notice copy for staged comms
Prepare release-notes automation: changelog generator + per-customer callouts
Build small migration helper CLI prototype and list of model equivalences
Plan observability signals and dashboards to monitor migration progress and regressions
Schedule training for AE/CS with FAQ and escalation matrix
milestones: 2026-04-24: SDK warning PRs + docs migration guide draft
2026-05-08: Console notice implementation + telemetry hooks merged
2026-05-31: Public comms window opens (first newsletter + site banner)
communications_plan: Segment customers into: active usage, dormant, enterprise with dedicated contract, on-prem/private (comms via AM)
T-minus 90 days: private notice to enterprise customers with migration assistance offer
T-minus 60 days: in-product deprecation banners for active users + email to owners
T-minus 30 days: public Release Notes with migration guide link and SDK upgrade instructions
Launch day: blog post + changelog + social + support portal FAQ
Post-launch: weekly migration status updates to affected customers and internal slack channel
rollout_steps: 1) Blocker gating: ensure compatibility shim PR is merged (ENG)
2) Soft deprecation: add response headers and SDK warnings; turn on Console banner for 10% sample
3) Scale to 100% in-product notifications after 14 days if no critical regressions
4) Open migration support program for enterprise customers (concierge) with SLA
5) Begin disabling write-only endpoints for legacy version after grandfather window ends, keep read-only for additional 90 days
6) Final removal whitelist and force-deprecation after contractual exceptions resolved
monitoring_metrics: Migration adoption rate (percent of requests hitting new version) — daily
Error rate delta for migrated vs non-migrated traffic
Number of open migration support tickets by customer tier
Roll-forward/rollback trigger events logged and time-to-resolution
risks: High-volume customers may rely on undocumented behavior — mitigation: offer compatibility audit
SDKs introduce false positives in deprecation warnings leading to noise — mitigation: staged sampling + config flag
Console banner fatigue reduces visibility — mitigation: coordinate cadence and limit exposure per user
Legal constraints for on-prem/private customers slow forced removal — mitigation: negotiate exceptions and longer grandfather windows
Telemetry gaps prevent accurate migration metrics — mitigation: require ENG to instrument and QA dashboards before soft deprecation
notes: We should avoid an all-or-nothing sunset; prefer multi-tiered retirement with clear dates and exceptions
Consider a migration bounty or credits for customers who move within first 60 days
Coordinate with Growth for opt-in nudges in the Console for self-serve customers
Make migration guide copy extremely concrete: copy-paste snippets, common troubleshooting table
